title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: ESI-MS complements single-crystal X-ray diffraction by measuring charged cluster species in solution when crystals are unavailable or solution-phase composition and evolution are at issue.
explanation: Diffraction directly establishes suitable crystal structures, whereas ESI-MS provides mass-to-charge, charge-state, and composition evidence and can distinguish species in complex solutions.
scope: Characterization of lanthanide-containing clusters and their solution-phase species.
conditions: Samples must yield detectable ions in a suitable solvent and ion mode.
caveats: Mass assignments do not alone establish a complete three-dimensional structure or prove that all solution species have been observed.
